display_name: The means of signal between people (the information pipeline)
status: First pass, 18 October 2026 (docs/command/03_MEANS.md). The kinds and their properties follow utin_2018; the speeds and handling times are SAM3D estimates until the period's norms are read (docs/research/CHAIN_OF_COMMAND_RESEARCH_2026-10.md §7).
source: utin_2018 (the electrical, mobile and signal means; couriers' priority on roads; precedence and the 'Гранит' connection limits); fm100_2_3 (the regiment's despatch motorcycles and R-311 warning receivers, the division's courier platoon); speeds and handling times are SAM3D estimates
notes: Every fact that reaches a person comes by one of these. kind: in_person (talk, hand over a paper), messenger (on foot), despatch_rider (motorcycle, sent at once), courier (a scheduled run: data/command/chain_pannonia.json routines), field_telephone (the wire net), radio_voice, warning_receiver (the division's early-warning net heard on R-311 receivers), siren (the 'Воздух' alarm in a town), field_post, broadcast (state radio). speed_kmh: a carrier's road speed (the route is the straight line times road_factor). handling_s: writing, encoding, handing over and reading at both ends. connect_s: the telephone's time to get a connection, per transit exchange. range_km: reach (0: no limit). loss: chance a message is lost or garbled beyond use, before air attacks and cut wire. intercept: how much one message tells the enemy's radio intercept service (0 none, 1 everything it carries). documents: carries papers in full (orders, the intelligence summary, overlays); voice carries a summary. precedence: the highest precedence it is used for (0 routine, 1 priority, 2 'Воздух'/'Гранит').

relay.source: SAM3D estimate: the time an NPC takes to take a fact in and pass it on (urgent, priority, routine), scaled by the holder's skill tier (data/crew/skill_levels.json names); max_wait_h: a routine fact with no contact within this many hours goes the priority way at once; retry_h: a lost carrier's message is sent again after this

means.name: In person
means.source: SAM3D estimate (talking a fact through, handing over a paper)
means.notes: Only between people at the same place at the same time: a briefing, a visit, a meeting the player seeks out.

means.name: Messenger on foot
means.source: utin_2018 (посыльные carry documents); speed SAM3D estimate
means.notes: Within a position or between neighbouring ones: a runner from the command post to a vehicle.

means.name: Despatch rider (motorcycle)
means.source: fm100_2_3 (three motorcycles give the regimental commander messenger and courier service); utin_2018 (mobile means: documents in their original form, priority on roads and crossings); speed SAM3D estimate

means.name: Courier run
means.source: utin_2018 §6.6 (the circular route: one run from the senior post through its subordinates, the common scheme; couriers and military postmen); fm100_2_3 (the division signal battalion's courier platoon); speed and timings SAM3D estimates
means.notes: Runs only on its schedule (the routines of the chain file); carries routine facts and papers both ways.

means.name: Field telephone (TA-57, the wire net)
means.source: utin_2018 table 3.1 (a 'Гранит' call within 1 minute direct, 2, 3 and 5 minutes through one, two, three transit centres); fm100_2_3 (TA-57 and P-193M switchboard in the regimental signal company); the routine connection time and the losses are SAM3D estimates
means.notes: Both ends on the wire net and neither end's line cut (a bombing near a post, rubble in a town: utin_2018 §9.3).

means.name: Town telephone exchange
means.source: utin_2018 §9.3 (in a city the stationary telephone network may be used, with measures against eavesdropping; wire there is often broken by rubble and fires); times SAM3D estimates
means.notes: Between the town's offices (the garrison commandant, the national committee, civil defence, the police, the factories), and to the army's posts that have a line into it.

means.name: Radio (voice, R-123M and the regiment's nets)
means.source: utin_2018 (radio the main and often only means with units on the move; under intercept and jamming wire and mobile means are more covert); range: the R-123M's 4 m whip with the noise suppressor off (simcore/crew_comms.hpp, published ranges); handling and loss SAM3D estimates
means.notes: Heard by the enemy's radio intercept service: the air war's COMINT. With the EM layer on, the net's own model (em/comms_system.hpp) decides delivery and jamming.

means.name: Early-warning net (R-311 warning receivers)
means.source: fm100_2_3 (R-311 warning receivers in the regimental headquarters; SA-9 crews 'depend on preliminary target data broadcast over the division early warning radio net', registered in docs/research/EM_C2_SOURCES_2026-10.md); handling SAM3D estimate
means.notes: A broadcast from the division's air defence command post: everyone holding a receiver hears it at once.

means.name: Teleprinter over radio relay
means.source: utin_2018 §3.1 (a telegram's time: the auxiliary operations at both ends, waiting and transmission; 'Гранит' and 'Воздух' telegrams to 25 groups, others to 300); fm100_2_3 (R-401/405 radio relay at the regiment); handling SAM3D estimate
means.notes: Between the division and the regiment's command post: formal orders and the intelligence summary in writing.

means.name: Air-raid sirens ('Воздух')
means.source: utin_2018 (signal means; 'Воздух' the air-raid precedence); civil defence's sirens in every town: SAM3D reading of the period's states (docs/research/CHAIN_OF_COMMAND_RESEARCH_2026-10.md §5)
means.notes: Carries only the air-raid alarm, to everyone in the town.

means.name: Field post (letters, newspapers)
means.source: utin_2018 (the postal service: letters, parcels and the press, by military postmen); delivery time SAM3D estimate

means.name: State radio (the news)
means.source: SAM3D estimate (news bulletins on the hour; what the state chooses to say)
